changes_current_notice: A recorded revision does not establish what is selected in the current reading.
changes_limited: Only revision metadata is available. Further details are not disclosed.
changes_terms: Terms changed in these fields and data languages.
changes_proposal_detail: A value was proposed. A proposal does not establish publication.
changes_accepted_detail: A candidate was accepted in a Context. Acceptance alone does not establish selection.
changes_rejected_detail: A candidate was rejected in a Context.
changes_adopted_detail: A Context selection was recorded. Open the current reading to see what is available now.
changes_empty_page: No visible revisions on this page. Continue to check the next page.
board_community_global: This board is in Global Context. Posting uses the current account’s authority; there is no Realm membership to join.
board_community_protected_help: Reading this board does not grant permission to post.
board_feed_copy_failed: Could not copy the link. Open the thread to use its address.
realm_appearance_intro: Choose images and rules for this community. Changes take effect when you save.
realm_appearance_readonly: You can view these settings. Current Realm management permission is required to change them.
realm_appearance_unavailable: Appearance settings are currently unavailable. Your community has not been changed.
realm_appearance_preview_after_save: Image uploaded and processed. Save to apply it and load its preview.
realm_appearance_rules_help: Write or revise rules in the existing post composer, then select the published post and its exact revision. Later edits are not adopted automatically.
realm_appearance_selection_unavailable: This selection could not be confirmed. Your draft is preserved.
realm_appearance_clear_help: The source image or post is kept. Save to apply this change to the community.
realm_appearance_upload_pending: The uploaded reference is kept. We could not confirm an available image. Check it again before saving.
realm_appearance_uncertain: The save response was not confirmed. Your draft and original request are kept. Retry the same request to learn its outcome.
realm_appearance_conflict: Realm settings changed before this save. Your draft is kept. Refresh and review it against the current settings before saving again.
realm_appearance_review: Keep draft and use current head
zone_editor_live_note: Save replaces the current version. Saves to public and unlisted Zones are immediately visible. An unlisted link may be read anonymously.
zone_editor_signed_out: Sign in again to continue. Your local edits are retained.
zone_editor_closed: This operation is currently closed for this account.
zone_editor_denied: Your current access does not allow this action.
zone_editor_conflict: The saved version changed. Your edits are retained. Reload to discard them, or explicitly reapply them to the server version before saving again.
zone_editor_source_unavailable: Source execution is not ready. The server has not produced a preview.
zone_editor_dirty: Local edits are unsaved. Save before previewing or changing visibility.
zone_editor_actions_unavailable: Current action availability could not be read. Editing is disabled; retry the read.
zone_editor_saved: Configuration saved to the current head.
zone_editor_published: Visibility updated for the saved version.
zone_editor_validation: Review the marked configuration fields before saving.
zone_editor_navigation_note: Up to 16 pages, including Home. Navigation follows the sorted configured routes.
zone_editor_route_help: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with / between segments. No leading or trailing /. The first segment subjects is reserved. Home stays empty.
zone_editor_composition_note: Use the common page editor for blocks and page appearance. Its canvas is a local draft; data placeholders are not a saved preview.
zone_editor_source_note: Only released saved filters and readable Collections can be selected. Visibility grants no authority over mounted sources. Source execution remains gated and may be unavailable.
zone_editor_release: Available filters from release {release}. Saving uses the active release.
zone_editor_refresh: Read current server version and choices
zone_editor_preview_note: Preview reads the saved page with your current reader access. Unsaved changes are never sent. The reader link opens the current saved version.
zone_editor_copy_failed: Could not copy. Use the reader link above.
zone_editor_leave: Leave this page and discard unsaved local edits?
trending_unavailable: Trending searches are unavailable right now.
moderation_queue_conflict: The report or target has changed. Refresh the current state and review it before making a new decision.
moderation_queue_denied: You do not currently have permission to perform this moderation action.
moderation_queue_sign_in_required: Sign in again to review your current moderation access.
moderation_queue_uncertain: The response was lost. The action may have completed.
moderation_queue_refresh_hint: Your draft is kept. Refresh and review the current state before making another decision.
moderation_queue_refreshed: Current state refreshed. Review it before making a new decision. Your draft is kept.
library_collection_move_pending: {count} members will move to {title} when you save.
library_collection_move_save_first: Save or cancel member edits before choosing a move.
content_edition_unavailable: This edition is unavailable right now. Its document could not be read from the protected source. Try again later.
content_edition_refused: This edition cannot be opened with your current access.
content_edition_withdrawn: This edition has been withdrawn and cannot be read.
content_edition_version_mismatch: The source did not match this edition’s fixed version. The document has not been displayed. Try reading it again.
content_edition_attribution: This document is the fixed revision identified below. Later edits are not included. The licence is the source’s recorded declaration.
recipe_empty: The released recipe fields are unavailable. Try again later.
recipe_created: Recipe created. Its initial facts are selected in the current reading.
recipe_ingredients_help: Ingredient text, material links and dietary claims are separate. Select existing subjects for links and cite your claims.
recipe_method_help: Write your own instructions, with an explicit language tag and SPDX licence. Existing documents stay intact; this creates a new replacement.
recipe_original: These instructions are my original writing.
library_collections_denied: Your Collections are not available with your current access.
library_collections_unavailable: Your Collections are unavailable right now. Try again.
condition_hint: Combine typed conditions. Existing text and refinements also apply.
condition_metadata_unavailable: Condition definitions are unavailable. Your submitted conditions are retained.
condition_retained: This existing condition is retained. Selection and editing are unavailable here.
condition_required: Choose or enter a value for this condition.
condition_bounds: Check the range and limits: 32 conditions including qualifiers, depth 4, 16 OR branches, 64 values and 4 qualifiers per statement.
condition_invalid: Check this condition’s value, type and format.
condition_unsupported: This condition is not supported for this search.
condition_text_error: Check the search text and its 512-byte limit. Your query is retained.
condition_cursor_error: This continuation is invalid. Restart with the current conditions.
order_reconcile_queued: Status check queued. Payment and access are not confirmed by this request. Refresh the page for current access.
order_reconcile_unavailable: Status checks are unavailable right now. Your last verified payment and access remain unchanged.
order_reconcile_error: The request outcome is unknown. Retry with the same request.
order_reconcile_denied: This status check is no longer permitted. Refresh the page to check current permissions.
order_reconcile_hint: Request a fresh check of this recorded purchase. This does not create another payment.
edition_publication_resume_help: This edition keeps its original revision, subject and licence. These values cannot be changed. Source text is not provided by the saved draft metadata.
edition_publication_missing: This edition cannot be found or is no longer available to you. No replacement draft has been created.
edition_publication_withdrawn_help: This edition has been withdrawn and cannot be published again.
edition_publication_intro: Preserve one of your authored revisions as a fixed edition. Create a draft, review its source and licence, then publish it.
edition_publication_sign_in: Sign in to select and publish your own authored revision.
edition_publication_selection_help: Open one of your posts, choose its exact revision from history, and use “Create a fixed edition”. You can also paste that revision link here.
edition_publication_invalid_link: Use an exact post revision link from this site.
edition_publication_loading: Checking the current source and publication…
edition_publication_uncertain: The response was lost or could not be confirmed. Your selection and original request are retained. Retry the same request to learn its outcome.
edition_publication_conflict: The current version needs review. Read the current source and edition, then explicitly accept them before continuing.
edition_publication_refused: Native authorization or source checks refused this request. Your selection is retained. Read the current source before continuing.
edition_publication_unavailable: Edition publication is currently unavailable. Your work is retained; a native source and current authorization are required.
edition_publication_subject_help: Choose one subject already associated with this exact revision. Its current availability is checked before creating or publishing.
edition_publication_review_help: Review the source, original subject, licence and current edition version above. Accepting this review allows a new request; it does not publish the edition.
edition_publication_draft_help: This draft is not published or sellable. Publication requires a separate confirmation and current native authorization.
edition_publication_confirm: Publish the fixed snapshot of revision {revision}, under {licence}, for original subject {subject}. Later post edits will not change it.
edition_publication_published_help: Native publication and the current edition read are confirmed.
edition_publication_entry_heading: Publish this revision as an edition
edition_publication_entry_help: Create a fixed draft from this exact authored revision and one of its original subjects. Your post stays as it is.
realm_discovery_popular_window: Public discussion activity over the previous 30 complete UTC days.
realm_discovery_trending_window: Public discussion activity over the previous complete UTC day.
realm_discovery_empty: No Realms to show for this period.
realm_discovery_page_empty: No Realms on this page. Continue to see more.
realm_discovery_closed: Realm discovery is not open yet.
creator_offers_intro: Review your captured offer terms, including delisted history. Listing history does not confirm current permission to sell or read the content.
creator_offers_unknown: Unknown benefit mapping. This historical offer does not identify licensed content.
creator_offers_captured: Fixed edition terms captured. Current content availability and selling permission are checked separately.
creator_offers_page_empty: No more offers on this page.
creator_offers_empty_hint: Offers you own will appear here.
creator_offers_denied: You cannot view offers with this account and permission.
creator_offers_unavailable: Your offers are unavailable. Try again.
creator_offers_error: This page address is invalid. Start from the first page.
creator_offers_stale: This page has expired. Start from the first page.
benefit_fixed_version: This purchase covers one fixed version. Later edits and other editions are not included.
benefit_acquisition: One-time purchase · quantity 1 · bound to the purchasing account
benefit_reader_notice: The reader checks current availability. A paid purchase or active record does not guarantee that the edition can be opened.
benefit_terms_unavailable: The captured edition details are unavailable. No readable edition can be identified here.
realm_claim_owned: The current Realm has an owner. Governance follows current permissions; this does not establish your ownership.
realm_claim_orphaned: This Realm has no owner. Discussions remain readable under their usual access rules. Settings, board creation and publication are read-only while ownership is unresolved.
realm_claim_unavailable: Current Realm ownership is unavailable. Refresh before requesting review.
realm_claim_admission_unavailable: Current request permission is unavailable. Refresh to check access.
realm_claim_eligibility: The original waiting period is 720 hours. Dates are informational; eligibility and access are checked when you request review. Waiting or requesting does not grant ownership.
realm_claim_review_help: Your request is awaiting a platform decision. This confirms submission only, not approval or a place in a first-come queue. Keep the reference for questions about the review.
realm_claim_copy_failed: Copy is unavailable. Select the request reference above to copy it.
realm_claim_uncertain: The reply was lost or unavailable. Submission is unconfirmed. Retry the same request to recover its result; your request key has been kept.
realm_claim_conflict: The request conflicts with current eligibility or Realm state. Refresh, then review the current source before preparing another request.
realm_claim_refused: The request is not currently permitted. Your request has been kept. Refresh to check current access before continuing.
settings_account_rename_policy: Your former handle forwards to your current handle for 30 days, then stops forwarding. It remains permanently unavailable to other accounts.
settings_account_rename_confirmation: Continue to Auth to review the current signed-in account and explicitly confirm the change. Auth checks current permissions before renaming.
settings_account_rename_unavailable: Handle rename is unavailable. Reload to check your current account, permissions and Auth configuration.
realm_review_intro: Help an orphaned Realm find its next owner. Review the original request and confirm one approval at a time.
realm_review_empty: No pending requests on this page
realm_review_empty_help: This is the current queue result. Refresh to check for changes.
realm_review_sparse: No requests to show on this page
realm_review_sparse_help: The queue has another page. Continue when you are ready; this does not mean the queue is empty.
realm_review_unavailable: The review queue is unavailable. Refresh to try again before reviewing an approval.
realm_review_denied: You cannot review ownership claims with your current access. Refresh to check again if your access changes.
realm_review_signed_out: Your session is no longer available. Sign in again to review ownership claims.
realm_review_closed: Ownership claim review is currently closed. Refresh to check again later.
realm_review_confirm_help: The account below will become this Realm’s owner if the approval is accepted. Check the account identifier and original orphan episode before confirming. Current access and eligibility will be checked again.
realm_review_conflict: This request or Realm state changed. Refresh the current queue, then review it before preparing another approval.
realm_review_uncertain: The approval reply is unavailable. It may already have been applied. The original approval key is kept; check current access and retry that same approval to recover its result.
realm_review_success_help: The approval returned an owned receipt. The queue has been refreshed. Review the current queue before taking another action.
realm_review_refresh_after_approval: An approval receipt was received, but the current queue could not be refreshed. Refresh before continuing.
realm_review_guidance_dates: Each request belongs to its original orphan episode. The waiting period is 720 hours; the displayed dates do not establish current eligibility.
realm_review_guidance_authority: Only a currently permitted platform approval can appoint an owner. Membership or a Realm role alone does not grant approval access.
realm_review_guidance_privacy: Review uses account and request identifiers. Account profiles, request bodies and private Realm details are not included.
